start: Welcome page of the admin app, not signed in, no gym in this browser

steps.action: Read the card 'See it working'
user_sees: Words: 'Opens a sample gym with made-up members, payments and a shop.'
Button 'Start demo'
must_not: The demo button drawn as the bright main button (that is 'Sign in' or 'Create my gym')

steps.action: Tap 'Start demo'
user_sees: Button reads 'Starting your demo gym…' and every button on the page is off
Then the Today page of a sample gym with made-up members, a gym code and a shop card
must_not: Two demo gyms made by one tap
A blank Today page
Landing on the page the last gym was left on

steps.action: Open Invite members and scan its QR with the MettleUp app on a phone, order something
user_sees: The order shows up in the demo Shop
must_not: The phone joining a different gym than the one on screen

start: The demo address of the admin app (/demo), opened from the website

steps.action: Open the demo address
user_sees: A sample gym with made-up members, kept only on this page
Parts that need the server are switched off with a plain line saying this is the demo
must_not: Any call reaching the gym server
The gym this device is signed in to being read, changed or signed out

steps.action: Close the tab and open the admin app normally
user_sees: The sign-in page, or the gym this device was signed in to, untouched
must_not: Demo members mixed into a real gym

steps.action: Tap 'Start demo'
user_sees: Error banner 'Can’t reach MettleUp. Check the internet and try again.'
Button now reads 'Try again'
A second button 'Open the demo without the shop. It works without internet.'
must_not: An endless spinner
A half-made demo gym left in this browser
Raw server words on screen

steps.action: Tap 'Open the demo without the shop. It works without internet.'
user_sees: The sample gym opens with made-up members and no shop card
must_not: A gym code shown for a gym that does not exist on the server

start: A browser that started a demo gym earlier

steps.action: Close the browser and open the admin app again
user_sees: The same demo gym with the same gym code, no question asked
must_not: A new demo gym made on every visit
The demo members gone while the gym code stays

steps.action: Open the demo after its gym was removed from the server
user_sees: Back on the Welcome page with 'That demo gym is no longer available. Start a new one below.'
An empty gym in place of the sample members
must_not: Sample members left behind with a dead shop
An error on every page with no way out

steps.action: In Settings tap 'Start over with a new demo gym', then 'Start over'
user_sees: The Welcome page again, where 'Start demo' makes a new one
must_not: 'Start over' offered to a real gym that only turned the shop on

start: Welcome page, about to start a demo

steps.action: Tap 'Start demo' and look at what was stored
user_sees: Made-up members stay in this browser
The server gets only a gym named for the demo, its code and 12 sample products; this browser keeps the key that opens it
must_not: Any real person’s name or number sent to the server
The key shown on screen or put in a link
Another visitor’s demo gym opening in this browser

start: Today page of a real gym kept in this browser, member app not turned on

steps.action: Read the card 'Let members order from your gym in the MettleUp app.'
user_sees: Words: 'Turn on the shop to get your gym code. It comes with 12 sample products you can change or delete.'
Button 'Turn on the shop'
must_not: A gym code shown before the shop is on

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on the shop'
user_sees: Button reads 'Turning on…' and is off
Then 'Members join in the MettleUp app with this gym code:' with a 6-letter code
The 'Shop today' card appears beside it
must_not: Any member, plan or payment of the gym changed or erased
Two gyms made by one tap
A code that differs between Today and Settings

steps.action: Open Shop, Products
user_sees: 12 sample products
must_not: An empty shop
Another gym's products

start: Settings, Branding, in a gym whose member app is not on

steps.action: Open Settings, Branding
user_sees: A card titled 'Turn on the member app first' with the same 'Turn on the shop' button
must_not: The branding form shown for a gym that has no app yet

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on the shop'
user_sees: The branding form loads in place of the card
must_not: A page that needs a reload to show the form

start: The 'Turn on the shop' card, with the internet off or the server busy

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on the shop' with no internet
user_sees: An error banner in plain words about the internet
The button back to 'Turn on the shop'
must_not: A gym code shown for a gym that was not made
Raw server words
The button left off for ever

steps.action: Sign in as staff and open the same place
user_sees: 'The member app and shop are not turned on yet. Only an owner can turn them on.' and no button
must_not: Staff able to turn the shop on

start: Settings of a real gym that turned the shop on in this browser

steps.action: Tap 'Disconnect the shop', then 'Disconnect'
user_sees: 'Shop disconnected. Your members and payments are still here.'
The 'Turn on the shop' card is back on Today
must_not: Any member or payment erased
A 'Start over' button offered to this real gym

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on the shop' again
user_sees: A gym code
The owner is told plainly if this is a new code and members must join again
must_not: Members who joined with the old code left in a gym nobody can open, with no word to the owner
Old orders shown as lost without a reason

steps.action: Reopen the browser later
user_sees: The same gym code and shop, without tapping anything
must_not: The shop turned off by a reload

start: A real gym kept in this browser, shop just turned on

steps.action: Look at what left the browser
user_sees: Only the gym's name went to the server, with a new code and sample products
Members, payments and visits stay in this browser
must_not: Member names, phones or payments sent by turning the shop on
The key that opens the gym shown on screen, in a link or in a share message

steps.action: Open the admin app in another browser
user_sees: No gym: the key lives only in the first browser
must_not: The shop opening for anyone who only knows the gym code
